failureCodes: temBAD_AMOUNT — Amount is not a drops string or IOU object
actMalformed — Destination is not a classic r-address
notes: Do not submit from this tool. Autofill Fee/Sequence/LastLedgerSequence on a connected Client.
Native XRP Amount is a drops string via xrpToDrops. Never a JS number.

from xrpl.models.transactions import Payment
from xrpl.utils import xrp_to_drops

tx = Payment(
    account=wallet.classic_address,
    destination="rDestination...",
    amount=xrp_to_drops("0.001"),
)

failureCodes: tecNO_LINE_INSUF_RESERVE — not enough XRP reserve for a new line
notes: LimitAmount.currency is 40-hex for codes longer than 3 characters (RLUSD → 524C555344…).
Receiver needs a matching trust line (or rippling) before they can be paid an IOU.

tx = TrustSet(

failureCodes: tecPATH_DRY — no trust line / rippling path to the destination
temBAD_AMOUNT — currency must be 40-hex RLUSD, not the ASCII string
notes: TrustSet the hex currency on the destination before Payment.
This tool does not submit or move funds.

failureCodes: tecUNFUNDED — not enough XRP to fund the channel
notes: Channel ID comes from Create metadata; claims use PaymentChannelClaim.
x402 on XRPL usually uses presigned Payment blobs, not channels, unless you opt into a channel facilitator.
